title: About Isolation Profiles for Internet & SaaS

blocks.text: When creating an Internet & SaaS (ZIA) policy with the action as Isolate, you must reference an isolation profile in the policy you're creating. These profiles determine certain attributes and specifications about how the user interacts with the isolated web page, where the isolation containers are spun up, and what the isolation experience looks like to the user.
You can use Private Access (ZPA) isolation profiles to create policies in Private Access to isolate specific web applications. To learn more, see About Isolation Policy.

For any organization that is using Zero Trust Browser, Internet & SaaS and Private Access automatically create default isolation profiles. You can use the default isolation profiles or manually create isolation profiles to use in Internet & SaaS and Private Access policies. To learn more, see Default Isolation Profiles for Zero Trust Browser.

For certain levels of Internet & SaaS and Zero Trust Browser integration access, admins are provided with preconfigured profiles that can only be partially edited. To learn more, see Understanding Isolation of Miscellaneous and Unknown Category in Internet & SaaS and Editing an Isolation Profile for Internet & SaaS.
On the Isolation Profiles page (Zero Trust Browser > Browser Isolation Internet Access > Isolation Profile & Banner > Isolation Profiles), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Customize the columns shown in the table.
View a list of existing isolation profiles and their details.
You cannot delete default isolation profiles.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
Go to the Isolation Banner page.
